{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

example (a b : UInt64) (h : ¬ a < b) : b ≤ a := UInt64.not_lt.mp h

example (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64) (s' : State)
    (h : step p s now to amount = (.allow, s')) : amount ≤ p.perTxCap := by
  unfold step at h
  split at h
  · split at h
    · cases h
    · next hnlt => exact UInt64.not_lt.mp hnlt
  · cases h

end Solution
"}
